I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says the project's recorded decision is argon2id, chosen because it is much more resistant to GPU-based attacks.

The record behind it is decision #11, stated by the user, and nothing later replaces it. `muninn why` reported "insufficient", because no record has a trust level above 3 and the only matching decision is the user's own statement. I treated that statement as current since no later decision retires it.

The file also says that no parameter values (memory, iterations, parallelism) are recorded. It doesn't mention the retired bcrypt choice, as you asked.

The Muninn heartbeat is red. Hooks have started 20 times without finishing, so one is probably exceeding its timeout. `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` has the details.
